answer.reason: The BLS QCEW fourth-quarter 2024 data for West Virginia lists the December 2024 private-sector employment level for NAICS 54 (Professional, scientific, and technical services) as 30,916 covered jobs, not 32,900.

metadata.prompt:
Question: In the BLS QCEW fourth-quarter 2024 data for West Virginia, what was the December 2024 private-sector employment level, in covered jobs, for NAICS 54 Professional, scientific, and technical services?

A. 32,900 covered jobs
B. 30,916 covered jobs

Source citation: BLS QCEW Open Data, West Virginia statewide, 2024 Q4 (https://data.bls.gov/cew/data/api/2024/4/area/54000.csv)

Supplied draft answer: A
